newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African wool prices fall at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: South African wool prices fall at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were lower at the season's weekly auction, the Wool Board said on Friday.
It said 11,242 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 95 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron shed 5.4 percent to 23.82 rand/kg, 21 micron dropped 3.8 percent to 21.77 rand/kg, 22 micron fell 1.3 percent to 19.92 rand/kg, 23 micron declined 0.6 percent to 18.03 rand/kg, 24 micron gained 0.5 percent to 17.35 rand/kg and 25 micron dropped 0.2 percent to 16.80 rand/kg.
Prices for Merino bellies shed 5.3 percent to 17.26 rand/kg, Merino lambs dropped 2.9 percent to 22.60 rand/kg and Merino locks was 0.4 percent cheaper at 13.69 rand/kg.
